articles.summary: Paul Abbott moves to Operating Partner with Long Lake Drew Crawley appointed CEO American Express Global Business Travel (Amex GBT) today announced a planned leadership transition as the company begins its next chapter in partnership with Long Lake. Paul Abbott will move to a new role as Operating Partner with Long Lake. Drew Crawley, currently President of Amex GBT, will succeed Abbott as Chief Executive Officer. The leadership transition will take effect immediately. Abbott led Amex GBT for the past seven years, overseeing a period of significant growth and transformation, including navigating the disruption of the global pandemic, the strategic acquisitions of Egencia and CWT, product and technology transformation, going public in 2022, and culminating in completing the world’s first AI-focused take-private deal. articles.title: Amex GBT Announces Planned CEO Transition
